mapper.select: SELECT * FROM knowledgedb WHERE user_id = #{userId} and name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{dbname}, '%');
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO knowledgedb (name, user_id,create_time, update_time, file_num) VALUES (#{dbname}, #{userId}, NOW(), NOW(), 0);
